metadata.description: Agent skills for working with Cassis, the living context layer for analytics agents

plugins.name: cassis-ontology-authoring
plugins.description: Extend and enrich a Cassis ontology that lives in a git repository. Turns schema dumps, dbt YAML, query history and internal docs into validated ontology files, delivered as a pull request.

plugins.name: cassis-snowflake-mcp
plugins.description: Ask plain-language data questions with Cassis and Snowflake together when Cassis is not natively connected to the warehouse. Cassis grounds the question and returns SQL, Snowflake executes it.
